resources.string: Willbolt uses this permission for three things, all on your phone: (1) to see which app or website is open (it reads the app name, window text and the browser address bar) so it can block the ones you chose and count your time in apps; (2) to take a screenshot every few seconds and check it for adult content with a model on the phone - the picture is never saved or sent; and (3) to press Home or lock the screen when something is blocked. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
While Willbolt is a device administrator, Android asks you to deactivate it before Willbolt can be uninstalled. Willbolt requests no other administrator powers.
